specs.Operating System : Google TV: Ram Capacity: 1 GB | Storage Memory: 8 GB

specs.Integrated Speaker System: These powerful speakers bring you a more immersive and surrounding experience.
specs.Intelligent Sound Mode: The Intelligent Sound Mode enables the User, Standard, Vivid, Sports, Movie, Music, and News Sound modes according to the choice and content.
specs.Metallic Bezel-Less: The metallic bezel-less design allows a full-screen and wider visible viewing experience, just feels right amongst all the action.
specs.Multiple Viewing Mode: Transform your living room into a heaven with the Movie Mode, Game Mode, and Sports Mode via this TV.
specs.Movie Mode: The Movie Mode adjusts brightness and contrast for deeper blacks and vibrant visuals.
specs.Game Mode: The Game Mode reduces input lag for a more responsive gaming experience.
specs.Sports Mode: The Sports Mode boosts the brightness and colour contrast for a more vivid viewing experience.
specs.Ok Google: With Ok Google, you can ask Google about the weather, sports scores, and more, and get answers right on the screen.
specs.Built-in Chromecast: The Chromecast helps to stream content from Macs or laptops, iPads, and phones onto the big screen.
specs.Google Watchlist: You can even add your preferred shows and movies to your Watchlist from your phone or laptop through Google Search on any browser.
specs.Quad Core Processor: This TV allows a 64-bit Quad-Core Processor with 8 GB Storage and 1 GB RAM.
specs.Connectivity: This TV enables you to stream faster, further, and more stably with Bluetooth 5.0, HDMI, and USB.
specs.Quick Settings: In Quick Settings, you can freely add commonly used system settings and freely set the function order, making TV system settings more convenient.
